question: 单项选择：I _____ TV at 8 o'clock last night. A. watch  B. watched  C. was watching  D. am watching
answer: 答案：C. was watching。解析：at 8 o'clock last night是过去某一点时间，"正在做"用过去进行时。

question: 用所给词的适当形式填空：They ______ (play) basketball at that time yesterday.
answer: 答案：were playing。解析：at that time yesterday提示过去进行时。主语they用were。

question: 单项选择：She _____ when the phone rang. A. cooks  B. cooked  C. was cooking  D. is cooking
answer: 答案：C. was cooking。解析：when the phone rang是一般过去时，"当...时正在做"用过去进行时。

question: 单项选择：What _____ you _____ at 9 o'clock this morning? A. are, doing  B. were, doing  C. did, do  D. was, doing
answer: 答案：B. were, doing。解析：at 9 o'clock this morning是过去时间，特殊疑问句用were + 主语 + doing。

question: 翻译句子：昨天下午三点我在公园里玩。
answer: 答案：I was playing in the park at three yesterday afternoon. 解析：过去进行时：was/were + 动词-ing。

question: 用所给词的适当形式填空：The kids ______ (sleep) when I got home.
answer: 答案：were sleeping。解析：when引导的一般过去时，主句用过去进行时。

question: 单项选择：He _____ a book at 10 last night. A. read  B. is reading  C. was reading  D. reads
answer: 答案：C. was reading。解析：at 10 last night是过去时间点，"正在做"用过去进行时。

question: 单项选择：We _____ dinner when the lights went out. A. have  B. had  C. were having  D. are having
answer: 答案：C. were having。解析：when the lights went out是一般过去时，主句用过去进行时。

question: 用所给词的适当形式填空：She ______ (write) a letter when I called her.
answer: 答案：was writing。解析：when I called her是过去时，主句用过去进行时。

question: 单项选择：I _____ my homework all evening yesterday. A. do  B. did  C. was doing  D. am doing
answer: 答案：C. was doing。解析：all evening yesterday是过去一段时间，用过去进行时。
